_comment: Alert thresholds as data (bead rzo.5) — loaded by app/alerts.py. Per-bay dwell windows are config, not code (invariant 5 style): 'dwellMinutes' is the default, 'dwellMinutesByBay' overrides per stable bay id. 'activeHours' is the UTC window in which yard activity is expected; episodes opening outside it raise afterHours alerts.
